subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR continue to require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the source-contract and focused-test proof?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for external PRs, while this Codex path has a source-proven helper gap but unresolved producer-path uncertainty.

options.title: Require live proof and refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and add redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording for the read-only and mutating warning cases.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the proof gate if the sibling Codex source contract plus focused OpenClaw tests are enough for this risk.

options.title: Let cleanup wait
options.body: If there is still no contributor response after the no-activity window fully qualifies, revisit this PR for stalled-unproven cleanup.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and refresh
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and add redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording for the read-only and mutating warning cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the shared tool mutation, warning, and native-hook relay surfaces affected by the proof decision.
